post.description:
When you have a trade mark number (UK000..., or UK009... for a comparable mark derived from an EU trade mark, domain 23). An unknown number is a not_found failure.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Declared unit rate: $0.0001 USD per provider_credit. Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

domain.description:
Register domain as the site encodes it: 1 national UK mark (default), 23 comparable UK mark derived from an EU trade mark (UK009 numbers), 4 UK mark registered at WIPO, 2 international registration designating the UK.

Provider reference: allowed values ["1", "23", "4", "2"]; default "1".

number.description: Trade mark number (UK00003500001; a bare digit string is zero-padded to the UK000 form; A/B series suffixes are kept) or a pasted case detail URL.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Read the case detail of one trade mark on the UK register: status, mark text or image, filing, registration and renewal dates, priority claim, goods and services by class, owners (with IPO client id), representatives and publications.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dates` | object[] | Every entry of the Dates section with the site's own label. |
| `domain` | string |  |
| `filing_date` | string |  |
| `goods_services` | object[] |  |
| `history_url` | string | The site's 'View historic details' page; get_trade_mark_history reads it. |
| `mark_text` | string | First textual representation of the mark; null for purely figurative marks. |
| `number` | string |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `owners` | object[] |  |
| `priority` | object | Priority details section; null when the mark claims no priority. |
| `publications` | object[] |  |
| `registration_date` | string | The site's 'Date of entry in register'; null while an application is pending or was refused/withdrawn. |
| `renewal_date` | string | Next renewal due date; null when the mark is not registered. |
| `representations` | object[] | Every slide of the mark carousel: series marks have several. |
| `representatives` | object[] |  |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `status` | string | Register status as printed: Registered, Withdrawn, Refused, Dead, Application published, ... |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

post.description:
Start here when you know a company or person name but not a trade mark number. An owner name that matches nothing returns zero owners, not an error.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->

name.description: Owner name or part of it, as the register spells it (case-insensitive substring match on the site). At least one of name or postcode is required.

page.description:
1-based result page; the site serves 20 owners per page.

Provider reference: minimum 1; default 1.

postcode.description: UK postcode in standard format, e.g. SN16 0RP.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
